lifecycle.title: Data retention
lifecycle.lead: Everything that grows on its own is cleaned by retention. Terms can be changed within allowed bounds.

safeMode.title: Safe mode: disk space is critically low
safeMode.body: Large uploads are rejected until space is freed.

warning.title: Disk space is running out
warning.body: Free some space or grow the volume before the critical threshold.

audit_log.title: Audit log
audit_log.body: Who did what. Monthly partitions; old ones are dropped whole.

ai_usage.title: AI call log
ai_usage.body: One model call through the gateway, no bodies.

jobs.title: Jobs and build logs
jobs.body: Finished job rows, their logs and stored outputs.

mail_log.title: Mail log
mail_log.body: Which mail went to whom and how sending ended. Mail bodies and links are not kept.

collab_requests.title: Invitations and access requests
collab_requests.body: Closed invitations, access requests and transfers.

share_links.title: Share links
share_links.body: Revoked and expired links with their visits.

collab_state.title: Co-editing state
collab_state.body: .ystate files on disk; secondary, rebuilt from the file.

auth_records.title: Sessions and tokens
auth_records.body: Expired sessions, one-time tokens, sign-in counters and device codes.

deleted_projects.title: Deleted projects
deleted_projects.body: Trash: purged after the environment retention.

orphans.title: Orphans
orphans.body: Folders and objects of projects missing from the catalog.

runner_commands.title: Runner commands
runner_commands.body: Disk measurements and cleanups sent to runners from the admin: the last 20 per runner, older ones are removed on write.

compile_records.title: Build records
compile_records.body: Last 50 per document, older ones removed on write.

chat_history.title: AI chat history
chat_history.body: Bounded by run count and trace size.

lifecycle_sweeps.title: “Free up space” runs
lifecycle_sweeps.body: Progress and outcome of cleaning every source with one button in Storage.

container_logs.title: Container logs
container_logs.body: Docker rotation: up to 5 files of 10 MB.

postgres_wal.title: Postgres WAL and autovacuum
postgres_wal.body: Managed by Postgres; database size is shown above.
